name: ID lookup: ./index.json route, LookupModal, Cmd/Ctrl+F keyboard binding
purpose: Build `./index.json` from `BuiltTreeModel` on every rewalk - one row per document id plus one per AC, carrying `{ id, kind, title, snippet, parent, tab }` - and render the LookupModal that opens from the SearchButton or Cmd/Ctrl+F, ranks results per design doc section 6 and picks `#tab=<tab>&entity=<id>` through the existing writeHash so `embed` and `theme` survive. The index is a new route, fetched lazily on first open and refreshed when the SSE tree-changed event lands.
responsibilities: src/view/view-index.js: buildViewIndex(model) returns `{ rows: Array<{ id, kind, title, snippet, parent, tab }> }` from a BuiltTreeModel. One row per PRD, REQ, US, TAD, TAC, ADR, BS, FBS, TS; one row per AC under each US; snippet is the first 110 chars of the document's description (or purpose / summary / context, the kind's prose field) with whitespace collapsed; parent is the walker-visible parent id (US for an AC, REQ for a US, PRD for a REQ, TAD for a TAC or ADR, BS for a FBS, US for a TS); tab is the viewer tab that owns the id (overview / requirements / architecture / build; TS carry the US's tab).

src/server/routes.js + src/server/index.js: new route `GET /index.json` returns `{ rows }` as application/json. Built once per rewalk (so the first fetch is served from an in-memory snapshot) and broadcast as part of the tree-update event version so the client knows to refetch.

src/view/html-page.js: a SearchButton (<button class="rcf-search-btn" data-rcf-search>) renders inside the shell's `<div class="tools">` right of the tabstrip, with the aria-label `Find any document or AC`. One hidden LookupModal (<div class="rcf-lookup" data-rcf-lookup hidden>) renders outside #rcf-live-content (next to the toast) so the SSE innerHTML swap cannot blow it away. The modal shell carries an input, a results list, an empty state and the reload affordance; results are rendered client-side.

src/view/page-init.js: wireLookup() lazily fetches `./index.json` on first open (XMLHttpRequest, same relative-script policy as PR 1), caches the parsed rows, listens for `rcf-tree-update` and marks the cache dirty for the next open; binds `(ctrl|meta)+F` (but not Shift+F) on `keydown` with preventDefault; drives type-ahead ranking (id-first exact/prefix/contains; then word match on title above snippet; single character is id-only; 20 result cap; matches marked); keyboard navigation up/down/Enter/Esc; a pick calls writeHash so `?embed=` and `?theme=` are preserved per PR 1's Dex contract.
src/view/style.css: `.rcf-search-btn` and `.rcf-lookup*` tokens aligned with the Stravica brand palette; focus trap and visible focus ring; empty-state and reload affordance in both themes.
internalStructure: Three composition seams. (1) `buildViewIndex(model)` is a pure projection of the model into a row list; it reads nothing beyond the model and returns a plain object. (2) The server snapshots the stringified index per rewalk alongside the content HTML; the route reads from the snapshot and never from disk. (3) `wireLookup` reads from the DOM only after the fetch resolves: the modal's input, the results list, up/down/Enter/Esc. The rank function is a pure function from (query, rows) to ordered results; the renderer paints one row per hit using the shared snippet-mark helper.

interfaces.name: GET /index.json
interfaces.description: [draft] Returns `{ rows: Array<{ id, kind, title, snippet, parent, tab }> }` for the current tree. Built once per rewalk; content-type application/json; relative to the viewer mount so wespa's reverse proxy sees `./index.json` under the mount point.

interfaces.name: buildViewIndex
interfaces.description: [draft] Pure projection of BuiltTreeModel into the index row list used by the LookupModal; one row per document id plus one per AC.

interfaces.name: renderLookupModal
interfaces.description: [draft] Emits the LookupModal shell HTML (input, results list, empty state, reload affordance) for the shell page; results are rendered client-side after the index fetch resolves.

interfaces.name: wireLookup
interfaces.description: [draft] Client-side wiring for the LookupModal: Cmd/Ctrl+F keyboard binding (page-init), SearchButton open, lazy `./index.json` fetch, SSE-driven cache invalidation, type-ahead ranking per design doc section 6, up/down/Enter/Esc keyboard navigation, pick writes `#tab=<tab>&entity=<id>` through writeHash so `embed` and `theme` survive.

notes: Depends on PR 1's Router (writeHash, resolveHash, parseHashParams, findByDocId, openAncestorDetails) and the relative-script policy (no leading slash, no inline script). The release notes name `./index.json` as a new route so wespa's proxy allow-list is extended before the version pin bump (Dex contract, design section 9). No outbound postMessage is added; the modal does not persist search terms. The route is the fourth or later such release-noted route (PR 1 landed `./page-init.js` as the first).
